Name: Better Crop Visibility
Author: KonaKona7
Description:
Ever get annoyed that the ancient fruit shows 3 tiny little blue berries that are hard to see when you're trying to pick a whole field of them?
Ever get lost in a sea of bright yellow corn tassels that blind your vision to the ears of corn that you haven't yet picked?
This mod redraws many of the in-game crops like grapes, starfruit, etc that are hard to see, so that you have an easier time harvesting.

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
Unzip and copy the Content folder into your Stardew Valley folder and replace existing file to install.
Replaces \Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets\crops.xnb
